description:
[Broker Sync API] List a user's connected brokerage accounts (normalized).

Use when you want a user's connected brokerage accounts in a normalized shape. Not for holdings (use broker_sync_positions) or cash (use broker_sync_balances).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).
name: broker_sync_connections
